root_text:
NPIs' unintended consequences:

Elimination or eradication of some common respiratory viruses

✅Eliminated for ~1.5 year: Parainfluenza, Comm. coronaviruses, RSV
✅Eliminated for ~2 years❗️: hMPV, Influenza❗️
✅Eradicated (most likely): FluB
